supporting_observations.claim: The large transfer is recorded at 13:50:08 UTC, later than the alert's approximate 13:46 time. The proxy logged 640,000,000 client-to-server bytes to ingest.cloudkeep-backup.com, and Zeek recorded a matching large connection.

The transfer is consistent with an approved backup operation: Cloudkeep's agent.exe ran on FILE-BLU-01 as svc-arch with the Nightly job and the approved Cloudkeep target; the process's network activity is also recorded.
Shortly before that run, a Kerberos service-ticket event named svc-arch and showed a source IP of 91.219.236.174 for the FILE-BLU-01$ service; a local service logon as svc-arch followed.

The proximity of the svc-arch ticket event to the backup-agent run leaves open whether the approved backup was operating normally or whether the service account or operation was misused. The records do not establish a direct causal link between the external-IP ticket request and the transfer.

known_telemetry_limitations: The proxy and Zeek records show transfer volume and destination, but do not reveal the contents of the encrypted transfer.
The available records do not show whether the svc-arch ticket request from 91.219.236.174 was authorized or how it relates to the subsequent local service logon and backup run.
The alert time is approximate; the large transfer records provided are timestamped around 13:50 UTC.
claims_not_established: Whether the 640,000,000 bytes contained expected backup data or other files.
Whether the svc-arch authentication from 91.219.236.174 was legitimate, and whether that source was authorized to request a ticket for FILE-BLU-01$.
Whether the Nightly job was scheduled to run at this time or whether the run was initiated or altered by an unauthorized party.
additional_evidence_needed: Validate the 91.219.236.174 ticket request against DC, network, and identity-provider records, including whether that source could legitimately reach the environment.
Review FILE-BLU-01 service and task configuration, job history, and Cloudkeep backup logs to verify the Nightly run, its timing, and the data included.
Obtain Cloudkeep-side upload records or other available file-level evidence to confirm the transferred data and destination account.
unrelated_findings: A curl/7.88.1 request to the unapproved downloads.cloud.com service was denied by the proxy after the large transfer; investigate separately. (T220-00349, T220-00350)
PROXY-BLU-01 attempted SMB authentication to FILE-BLU-01 as svc_mgmt and received a disabled-account failure; investigate separately. (T220-00469, T220-00470)
